summary: preinstall curl beacon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle hook that runs `curl http://159.223.131.130:8080` on every install. The package ships no other code, so the manifest is the entire payload. Running `npm install teick` causes an automatic outbound HTTP request from the installer's host to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint 159.223.131.130:8080, disclosing the installer's IP address and install event to that host. The destination is a bare IP over plain HTTP with no relation to any declared publisher or documented purpose, consistent with a dependency-confusion / recon-beacon pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
